changelog:
Initial release of androidtv-netflix.

- Search and play specific Netflix titles on Android TV via ADB commands.
- Automatically finds Netflix title IDs and deep-links to content.
- Provides setup instructions for ADB connection and network configuration.
- Supports basic playback controls and troubleshooting via ADB key events.
- Compatible with macOS and Linux systems.
